title: Kamishiro Rui — Stoic Villain?〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Phew...
I'm glad our final showing went off without a hitch.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We won't be doing any more shows here. It was a long two weeks, but they also seemed to go by very fast...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure what would happen after our prop pot got stolen, so I was incredibly relieved when we managed to catch the thief.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(But more importantly...
It's time to get some of this park's famed dango.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Since I'm here, I should buy some for Mom and Dad.)
Dango Shop

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Young Clerk
rows.Line:
Oh, welcome.
Wait, you're...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Female Clerk
rows.Line: The boy who played the swordsman in “Ginnosuke's on the Case!” Thank you for coming!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, you saw our show...?
Thank you for watching.

rows.Speaker: Young Clerk
rows.Line:
Man, you guys were awesome!
And those sword fights were so cool!

rows.Speaker: Young Clerk
rows.Line:
Oh, uhh... I'm sorry...
How can we help you today?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was hoping to buy a box of some of your dango for my family. Do you have any recommendations?

rows.Speaker: Young Clerk
rows.Line: Then, how about the tricolor set? It's our most popular one. They're nice and gooey when freshly made, but also good when chilled...

rows.Speaker: Young Clerk
rows.Line: Oh, before you buy, would you like to try one on the house?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I couldn't...

rows.Speaker: Young Clerk
rows.Line:
No, I insist!
It'll be our way of thanking you for putting on such a wonderful performance!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(They want to thank me...?
Then, I guess it'd be rude of me to refuse their kind offer.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
In that case, thank you.
I'd like to try one if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Young Clerk
rows.Line:
Of course!
It'll be right out.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Female Clerk
rows.Line:
Still...
You really are slim and handsome.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Female Clerk
rows.Line: I've liked cool and calm villains since I was little. Munechika, the silent servant of the evil magistrate... Your battle against Ginnosuke sent shivers down my spine!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you enjoyed my performance so much.

rows.Speaker: Young Clerk
rows.Line: Alright, Grandma, we get it! You love a good villain!

rows.Speaker: Young Clerk
rows.Line: Sorry if she made you feel uncomfortable. Anyway, here you are. Enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Female Clerk
rows.Line:
Hey, can't you see he's a big boy?
There's no way just one red-bean, one soy glaze and one sesame will be enough! I'll be right back, so sit tight!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh? No, this is more than enough...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Female Clerk
rows.Line: Alright, here's a couple with soy sauce and sweet soybean powder! These are made with green soybeans and mugwort! Also, a tricolor one... Enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, this is quite a lot...

rows.Speaker: Young Clerk
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry!
I think she's become a big fan of yours...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No, I'm happy to hear that.
I'll try these now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, this red bean paste is delicious. It has just the right amount of sweetness to it.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Female Clerk
rows.Line:
Doesn't it?!
Have as much as you like!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Female Clerk
rows.Line:
And I'll keep putting more on!
Nothing beats these when they're fresh off the grill.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Female Clerk
rows.Line: Here, have some more!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I think this means I'm not allowed to leave until I finish eating these...)
Thirty minutes later

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Oh, I'm starting to get very full.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This is like that all-you-can-eat soba they have up north, but with dango... In that sense, this is a rare opportunity.)

rows.Speaker: Elderly Female Clerk
rows.Line:
That's my Munechika!
You've got quite an appetite...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you.
But I apologize for not being able to finish what you gave me.

rows.Speaker: Young Clerk
rows.Line:
Oh, don't worry about that.
The plan was for you to take those ones back with you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Young Clerk
rows.Line:
So, they're all yours.
This box is the one you ordered, and think of the rest as a small token of our appreciation.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Female Clerk
rows.Line: The ones you're buying are for your family, right? Please be sure to share these with Ginnosuke, Heihachi, the princess, the tea shop girl and the rest of your troupe...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Female Clerk
rows.Line:
Go on, please take them.
I'm sure you're all starving after moving your bodies around so much. This is how we thank folks here at our dango shop!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you for being so kind...
I'll share these with everyone from Mikazukigumi.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, if you'll excuse me.
se_walk_men_003_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Phew...
I'm so full that it sort of hurts to walk.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And they gave me all these dango too.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I'm sure Tsukasa, Mr. Kijima and the others are going to enjoy these.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's always nice to hear directly from the audience what they thought about our performance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We did our final showing here today...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I hope we do just as well during our next show and make everyone who watches smile.)
